text_block_list.text: That was the day it all started.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
When my sis asked me to race her, that
was my
first step toward chasing after
her.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
That first step decided my way of life.
Now I'm
about to take a new first stЭпизод
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
A step toward a life where I'm always
running.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Brian! Brian! Brian! Brian!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: ...Sis.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: How was the Twinkle Series, Brian?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
It was exactly the way you said it would
be.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
A place where everyone is aiming
upward and
trying to reach the top.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: A place where the strong gather.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Hey, Sis...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
You're not satisfied with this either, are
you?
You're still reaching for the top,
right?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Hey! Over here! Hey!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: You can count me in too! Next time I'll pass everyone like ZOOM!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Haha, I see. You too, then. Hey, Brian?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Yeah?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: You've become an inspiration to others.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
To think my tiny little sister who always
chased
after me has gotten so big...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, let's all compete for the top
again. And
then, when we get there—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I'll take it for myself.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Haha, still as selfish as ever I see.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: So this is where you've been, President.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Heh, it seems I've been found out.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I apologize for the trouble, leaving you
to take
care of things so suddenly.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
No need to apologize. So, how did
Нарита Брайан
do?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Brian... To put things simply, she's
gotten much
stronger.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Simply watching her run sets my heart
dancing. It
calls out to one's innate
running instincts.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
She must be truly exceptional for you to
speak so
highly of her.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Quite... Were you to watch her run, I
have no
doubt you would feel the same.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I would very much like to pit myself
against her.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And so, this year's final Grand Prix, the
Arima
Kinen, draws to a close with
everyone looking
forward to what the
future holds.
